findings.quote:
(the smaller root gives the
symmetric solution \((n_{k},m_{k})\))
findings.reason: False: at k=0, the smaller root gives (1,1), whereas the symmetric pair is (1,2). Changing the quadratic root does not swap the coordinates. This error is redundant to the larger-root construction.

reason: The Pell recurrence and larger-root construction establish infinitely many distinct positive integer pairs with value 4. The false claim about the smaller root nevertheless fails strict submitted-text rigor.
